title: When the Protocol Sings
premise: Casper Crane smuggles memories in sealed neural drives through the contested orbits of Halcyon Station, where two rival fleets hover on the brink of war. When the colony's children begin dreaming the same dream — a song that turns out to be the buried consciousness of a massacred mining crew — Casper discovers the 'peace treaty' he's been paid to protect is built on an erased atrocity. To keep the lie alive long enough to evacuate the innocent, he must choose between preserving his own fabricated identity and broadcasting the truth that will shatter both fleets' legitimacy. In the end, he releases the song to every mind on the station, sacrificing his smuggled past and his freedom, but buying the colonists a justice no court would ever grant.
about_author: Lena Thornbury is the pen name of a former orbital logistics analyst who spent six years writing technical manuals before turning to fiction. She writes near-future science fiction about people who move illegal things through legal spaces, and lives somewhere with excellent radio reception.

chapters.title: Contraband in the Quiet Hours
chapters.summary: POV: Casper Crane. Running a routine memory-smuggling run past orbital customs, Casper takes an odd commission: a sealed drive containing nothing but a lullaby. That night, dockworkers' children wake screaming the same melody. Casper's emotional beat is unease — ten years of clean runs have made him arrogant, and for the first time the cargo feels like it's looking back at him.

chapters.title: The Dream That Belongs to Everyone
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Casper and Dr. Imani Reyes, station archivist. The shared dream spreads; Imani traces it to a decommissioned mining platform where four hundred workers died in an 'accident' both fleets blame on each other. The lullaby is their compressed final memory. Rising tension: Casper realizes his client is a fleet intelligence officer using him to keep the truth buried until war becomes convenient.

chapters.title: Two Fleets, One Lie
chapters.summary: POV: Casper. Cornered by his client, Casper learns the treaty keeping the fleets apart depends on the official accident story — the truth would trigger mutual retaliation. He races to decrypt the full memory while customs closes in and the children's dreams grow violent, replaying the massacre. Climax beat: cornered in the old platform's wreck, Casper plays the song and hears the dead speak with his own mother's voice.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: POV: Casper, closing with Imani. Casper hijacks the station's emergency band and streams the miners' memory into every mind aboard — including his own, revealing his identity is itself a purchased fabrication. Fleets stand down, stunned by shared grief; the children's dream ends. Resolution: arrested but unrepentant, Casper finds peace in finally knowing who he really was, as the colony begins building its own reckoning outside any court.
